status_meaning: Seeded by an agent from the GQA answer vocabulary, NOT curated by a human. Any rescue attributed to judgment_source=ontology must be reported separately and is discountable until a human sets this field to HUMAN_REVIEWED.
provenance: Pairs were chosen from common GQA gold-answer surface variants. They were NOT derived from, tuned on, or expanded by the model predictions being scored; doing so would make the ontology manufacture its own rescues.
rules: Bidirectional only: every pair is symmetric.
No hypernyms. 'dog'/'animal' is not a synonym pair, because crediting a hypernym credits a less specific answer than the question asked for.
No co-hyponyms. 'sofa'/'chair' is not a pair.
Surface variants, standard abbreviations, and British/American spellings only.
